description: This file defines the DerivativeDiscoveryDecorator class, which implements plugin discovery with derivative awareness in Drupal. It provides methods for managing plugin definitions, derivatives, and caching, and acts as a decorator for other discovery implementations.

classes.name: Drupal\Component\Plugin\Discovery\DerivativeDiscoveryDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for plugin discovery that adds derivative awareness.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a decorated discovery object.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves a plugin definition, including derivative processing.

methods.name: getDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves all plugin definitions with derivatives included.

methods.name: getDerivatives
methods.description: Adds derivative definitions to a list of base plugin definitions.

methods.name: decodePluginId
methods.description: Decodes a plugin ID into base ID and derivative ID.

methods.name: encodePluginId
methods.description: Encodes base plugin ID and derivative ID into a single string.

methods.name: getDeriver
methods.description: Retrieves or instantiates a deriver for a given base plugin.

methods.name: getDeriverClass
methods.description: Determines the deriver class name from a plugin definition.

methods.name: mergeDerivativeDefinition
methods.description: Merges base and derivative plugin definitions, prioritizing non-empty values.

methods.name: useCaches
methods.description: Enables or disables caching of plugin definitions.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Delegates method calls to the decorated discovery object.
